comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Google Translated name: "Viseu public costume sewing method"

Quest reward item from Episode 15 of the Jose storyline. Makes three color-custom male-only items for relatively low sewing ranks.

Yields:
Duke of Viseu's Hat (froofy-looking hat)
Duke of Viseu's Clothes (fancy outfit)
Duke of Viseu's Boots (nice shoes)

I don't know when Ep#15 is due to be released, though. Could be available now, could be available in an upcoming patch. I'll let someone else figure that out, as well as have the honor of filling out the recipe items' stat info. Cheers.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=6123 (quest guide), fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-date-201808.html (pics of the sewable items including color options), yukimiiro.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-481.html (recipe data + more item pics)

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: It comes from one of the Jose storyline quests called "Those who confront the raging waves". But that particular one wont be out until Chapter 3 of Order Of the Prince. That likely be at least a few more months away before we'll see it.
